text: The use of adjuvant steroids in the treatment of TB meningitis and pericarditis No recommendation NEW RECOMMENDATION (Recommendation 1.6.1) In patients with tuberculous meningitis, an initial adjuvant corticosteroid therapy with dexamethasone or prednisolone tapered over 6–8 weeks should be used (strong recommendation, moderate certainty of evidence) Recommendation is copied without modification into this consolidated document and appears exactly as in the 2017 guidelines.
